              <p>We’re updating Gemini to handle complex tasks like scheduling appointments, managing bills, and shopping for groceries. By connecting to your emails, calendar, and payment methods, Gemini saves you time while keeping your data secure in isolated environments. You can try these new capabilities today by switching the toggle from Chat to Task in the Gemini app, texting us on Android or iOS, or forwarding emails to gemini@google.com.</p>

              <ul>
<li>Josh Woodward, Vice President of Labs, announces that Gemini can now manage daily tasks for you.</li>
<li>You can use Gemini to schedule appointments, analyze utility bills, and purchase items through integrated services.</li>
<li>Gemini operates within secure, hardware-isolated virtual machines to protect your private data and account information.</li>
<li>You can access these new features by toggling the task mode in the Gemini mobile application.</li>
</ul>

            <small class="uni-ai-summary__legal font-body-xs">

          <div class="uni-ai-summary__summary " data-summary-id="ai_summary_3">
            <div class="uni-ai-summary__copy font-h6">
              <p>Josh Woodward, Vice President of Labs, Gemini app, and AI Studio, explains that Gemini can now handle daily tasks like scheduling appointments, managing grocery lists, and analyzing bills. By connecting to your Google apps, it securely completes chores using your existing information. You can activate these features by switching your Gemini app to task mode, texting, or forwarding emails. This update helps you save time by managing your calendar, shopping, and household organization.</p>

<section
  class="uni-page uni-grid uni-article-paragraph"
  data-analytics-module='{
    "module_name": "Paragraph",
    "section_header": "Put Gemini to work for you"
  }'>
  <uni-article-paragraph class="uni-article-paragraph__container uni-grid__col--layout-6">
    <div class="rich-text"><p data-block-key="fr94n">The best assistant knows you and helps you get things done. Today, you can now hand off even more tasks to Gemini and move on with your day. We’ve built it for anyone who has tasks piling up during all the classes, meetings, and school drop-offs that fill the day. Our goal is for Gemini to save you time and money.</p><p data-block-key="90trh">Starting now, this update is rolling out free of charge for hundreds of millions of people across the U.S., Japan, Korea, Canada, Australia, and India, using our new Gemini 4 Hydrogen model. We’re also rolling out a set of advanced features, starting in the U.S.</p><h2 data-block-key="e46q6">How it’s changing my daily routine</h2><p data-block-key="2nj0l">If your emails, calendar, passwords, photos, files, and payment cards are already in the Google ecosystem, Gemini is your best choice as a personal assistant because this sensitive data already lives at Google securely, and you don’t have to send it elsewhere.</p><p data-block-key="1ggrh">Here’s how I’m using it.</p><p data-block-key="8sh3u">Recently, our minivan’s check-engine light came on. Ugh. I pulled out Gemini and told it, "Our minivan is overdue for a service appointment. Please call the two nearest dealerships and figure out how to get an appointment early Friday morning over the next month or so."</p><p data-block-key="14jrd">Because Gemini already knows we drive a 2019 Honda Odyssey and where we live through <a href="https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/products/gemini-app/personal-intelligence/">Personal Intelligence</a>, it found the nearest shops on Google Maps and called both at once

<a class="superscript"
    data-ga4-analytics-superscript-click
    data-tooltip-content-id="footnote-content-1"
    data-target="inline text"
    href="#footnote-1"
    id="footnote-source-1"
    aria-label="Jump to link reference 1"><sup>1</sup></a>
. Thankfully, I didn’t have to suffer through any hold music. Gemini did the job, found a time in my Google Calendar when I was free, and added the Friday early morning appointment in less than five minutes. Done. (On the dealership's end, Gemini disclosed right away that it's an AI. Businesses can <a href="https://support.google.com/business/answer/7690269">opt out</a> whenever they want, and Gemini won’t give out my payment or private account info unless I say so.)</p></div>
  </uni-article-paragraph>
</section>

  

  
    





  

























<section class="uni-page uni-grid uni-inline-image-section" data-component="uni-inline-image">
  <uni-inline-image
    class="uni-inline-image uni-inline-image--full"
    alignment="full"
    alt-text="Rendering of someone using Gemini to decide when to book car maintenance"
    external-image=""
    or-mp4-video-title="Tasks blog"
    or-mp4-video-url="https://storage.googleapis.com/gweb-uniblog-publish-prod/original_videos/2611_TasksBlogMap_05_DZ.mp4"
    section-header="Put Gemini to work for you"
    
    
    
    
    
    
      autoplay="true"
    
  >
    
      <div slot="caption-slot">
        <div class="rich-text"><p data-block-key="28ntu">In the background, Gemini called both dealerships at once, sat through the hold music for me, booked an appointment at the shop that accepts appointments vs. walk-ins only, and put Friday's appointment on my calendar without me having to check it.</p></div>
      </div>
    

    
  </uni-inline-image>
</section>

  

  
    

<section
  class="uni-page uni-grid uni-article-paragraph"
  data-analytics-module='{
    "module_name": "Paragraph",
    "section_header": "Put Gemini to work for you"
  }'>
  <uni-article-paragraph class="uni-article-paragraph__container uni-grid__col--layout-6">
    <div class="rich-text"><p data-block-key="fr94n">Last month it saved us real money after we got hit with a surprise $389 electric bill. I gave Gemini permission to access our utility portal with the new Google Password Manager integration and asked for it to analyze our past billing statements in my email. Gemini worked for a few minutes, and then nailed it. The primary culprit was our heat pump, which it turns out was kicking on around 4 p.m., right in the middle of peak pricing. My wife and I never would have caught that digging through the PDFs and emails ourselves.</p><p data-block-key="clnrp">I use it for smaller stuff, too. For our upcoming holiday trip back to Oklahoma, I recently asked Gemini to give me the best options for a USB-C charger. Gemini quickly compared chargers thanks to Google’s Shopping Graph, asked me follow-up questions about the wattage and color, and then helped me check out using the new Google Pay integration. The best part: it also found a discount code so I saved an extra $10. Done.</p><p data-block-key="7plll">Gemini now uses the Agent Payments Protocol (AP2) to make purchases like this. We’re working with American Express (coming soon), Mastercard, and Visa to keep your purchases secure with digital tokens on supported cards. And when you shop with Gemini, you still earn your card's points, cashback, or purchase protections during checkout. You can also set a hard spending cap upfront, and Gemini is designed to stay within your budget. All of your receipts and tracking info land straight in Google Wallet, which is expanding to iOS <a href="https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/platforms/google-pay/wallet-available-ios-united-states/">starting today</a>. Up next, we’ll integrate the <a href="https://developers.google.com/merchant/ucp">Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP)</a> into Gemini so everyone can expect an even faster and more reliable shopping experience from discovery to checkout.</p></div>
  </uni-article-paragraph>
</section>

  

  
    





  

























<section class="uni-page uni-grid uni-inline-image-section" data-component="uni-inline-image">
  <uni-inline-image
    class="uni-inline-image uni-inline-image--full"
    alignment="full"
    alt-text="Texting groceries to Instacart"
    external-image=""
    or-mp4-video-title="Tasks blog"
    or-mp4-video-url="https://storage.googleapis.com/gweb-uniblog-publish-prod/original_videos/2611_TasksBlogText.mp4"
    section-header="Put Gemini to work for you"
    
    
    
    
    
    
      autoplay="true"
    
  >
    
      <div slot="caption-slot">
        <div class="rich-text"><p data-block-key="28ntu">Gemini lets you set the spending limit and still earn every airline mile, cashback point, and perk on your card.</p></div>
      </div>
    

    
  </uni-inline-image>
</section>

  

  
    

<section
  class="uni-page uni-grid uni-article-paragraph"
  data-analytics-module='{
    "module_name": "Paragraph",
    "section_header": "Put Gemini to work for you"
  }'>
  <uni-article-paragraph class="uni-article-paragraph__container uni-grid__col--layout-6">
    <div class="rich-text"><p data-block-key="fr94n">Gemini helps with weeknight dinners, too. I recently stared down a nearly empty fridge rushing out the door in the morning, and I texted Gemini with the new RCS integration

<a class="superscript"
    data-ga4-analytics-superscript-click
    data-tooltip-content-id="footnote-content-2"
    data-target="inline text"
    href="#footnote-2"
    id="footnote-source-2"
    aria-label="Jump to link reference 2"><sup>2</sup></a>
: “Add lasagna, strawberries, cucumbers, and vanilla ice cream to our Instacart order.” On the walk out, I saw an empty Cheerios box in the pantry, so I snapped a photo and sent a quick follow-up: “Add this too.” Gemini added it, and then handed me off to Instacart to complete the order. Groceries were on the doorstep when we got home. Done. Today, Gemini connects with more than 60 popular apps and, as a developer, you can apply to join our <a href="https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/developers-tools/connected-apps-one-place/">Connected Apps Platform</a>.</p><p data-block-key="8mm11">My wife and I also use Gemini to sort out medical bills, keep track of insurance renewals, and stay on top of our kids' schedules. Earlier this week, I forwarded a batch of school emails from Gmail to gemini@google.com. In less than a minute, every date was on my calendar with my wife invited. Better yet, it noticed a conflict during basketball practice and asked if I wanted to text one of the other parents to trade carpool duty.</p></div>
  </uni-article-paragraph>
</section>

  

  
    





  

























<section class="uni-page uni-grid uni-inline-image-section" data-component="uni-inline-image">
  <uni-inline-image
    class="uni-inline-image uni-inline-image--full"
    alignment="full"
    alt-text="Forwarding emails to Gemini"
    external-image=""
    or-mp4-video-title="Tasks blog email"
    or-mp4-video-url="https://storage.googleapis.com/gweb-uniblog-publish-prod/original_videos/2611_TasksBlogEmail_06_DZ.mp4"
    section-header="Put Gemini to work for you"
    
    
    
    
    
    
      autoplay="true"
    
  >
    

    
  </uni-inline-image>
</section>

  

  
    

<section
  class="uni-page uni-grid uni-article-paragraph"
  data-analytics-module='{
    "module_name": "Paragraph",
    "section_header": "Put Gemini to work for you"
  }'>
  <uni-article-paragraph class="uni-article-paragraph__container uni-grid__col--layout-6">
    <div class="rich-text"><h2 data-block-key="fr94n">How we protect your data</h2><p data-block-key="5i8lp">As Gemini becomes more capable, we continually advance our security defenses. When you assign Gemini a task, it uses <a href="https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/ai-infrastructure/agent-compute-engine-deep-dive">Google Cloud’s Agent Compute Engine</a> to work in a hardware-isolated virtual machine that’s dedicated to your account and never shared with other users. Each virtual machine is sandboxed, so Gemini works in a separate, isolated environment that’s regularly tested by our security red teams. This sandbox is just one of multiple layers of defense, including prompt-injection filters that scan search results, webpages, and more alongside Google Safe Browsing to limit which links Gemini can open.</p><p data-block-key="7l1p3">As Gemini works on a task, you can jump in to give it more instructions at any point, and it’s also designed to pause and check with you before critical steps. For example, Gemini is designed to ask for your confirmation or pre-approval before clicking "Buy," and will ask clarifying questions if an instruction is ambiguous. For routine stuff you already trust, like adding those Cheerios to your grocery cart, you can set that to “Always allow” so it doesn’t pester you.</p><p data-block-key="8dvec">And finally, we give you access to settings and tools that help you safeguard your data and protect your privacy. You can adjust task settings, disconnect Google and third-party apps, or delete chat history anytime. For a closer look at how we’ve implemented a multi-layer defense-in-depth security strategy, read our <a href="https://blog.google/security/how-geminis-defense-in-depth-approach-works/">technical paper</a>.</p><p data-block-key="a3qe6">And please participate in our bug bounty program through Google’s <a href="https://bughunters.google.com/about/rules/google-friends/ai-vulnerability-reward-program-rules">AI Vulnerability Reward Program (AI VRP)</a> to advance the security of agentic systems.</p><h2 data-block-key="9btuq">How you can help us improve</h2><p data-block-key="anlpm">While we’ve tested tasks extensively to minimize mistakes, we haven't eliminated all of them. You may encounter situations where a task fails to complete or misses the mark. When you see this, please provide feedback by giving the response a “thumbs down.”</p><p data-block-key="38d2p">For example, the way personal assistants navigate the web is still evolving as sites are still adapting to these new use cases. On some sites, Gemini can make it most of the way through and then hand the screen back to you to click the final button. We’re partnering directly with major websites and security providers to help the web evolve so it works well for site owners and personal assistants. For decades, bots were blocked by default because most were malicious. Personal assistants require a more nuanced approach, and we believe open, verifiable standards will benefit everyone.</p><h2 data-block-key="ctlg0">How to try it</h2><p data-block-key="4oi56">Ready to hand off your next task? Open Gemini, flip the home-screen toggle from Chat to Task, and tell Gemini what you need done. Starting in the U.S., you can also forward emails to <a href="mailto:gemini@google.com">gemini@google.com</a> or text Gemini by following these instructions:</p><ol><li data-block-key="7medq">Open Gemini on Android or iOS and tap <b>Settings</b></li><li data-block-key="f7tho">Tap <b>Channels</b></li><li data-block-key="54rb">Tap <b>Set up</b> under <b>Text with Gemini</b></li><li data-block-key="a76ja">Verify your phone number</li></ol></div>
  </uni-article-paragraph>
</section>
